g.text: Force isolation begins above r=√2 for the ideal spring-damper mount

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned force-excited machine on linear mounts; transmitted force is the spring-plus-damper reaction amplitude at the base. Increased damping suppresses
resonance but can increase high-frequency force transmission. The shaded region is mathematical isolation, not guaranteed performance of an actual multi-
mode machine. Base-motion transmissibility uses a related expression but a different input/output definition.
